subject: Define a layer as an object

messages.author: f76413c32828a961
messages.subject: Define a layer as an object
parts:
Hi folks,

It may be just a simple question using "parse" but I just can't get
it.

I am trying to plot 10 line plots with the same aesthetics but
different dataset. Instead of typing the long aes statement with
facet_wrap, scale colour etc over and over again, I am planning to do
something like this:

linewrap <- aes(x,y) + geom_line(aes(colour=event),size=1) +
facet_wrap(~group,ncol=3)

ggplot(data=myplot1) + linewrap
ggplot(data=myplot2) + linewrap
ggplot(data=myplot3) + linewrap
ggplot(data=myplot4) + linewrap

However, I do get an error. So I try parsing the "linewrap" and using
as.name and eval but it still doesn't work. Is there another way to
do it? Thank you so much!!!

Just to check that my installation is not corrupted, Do you receive an error
when executing the code bellow?
Thanks in advance,
fernando

library(ggplot2)

d1 <- data.frame(x = rep(1:10, 6), y = rnorm(60),
group = rep(c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"), each = 10),
grouk = rep(c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"), each = 10),
event = rep(c("1", "2", "3"), each = 20))

linewrap1 <- list(aes(x,y), geom_line(aes(colour=event),size=1),
facet_wrap(~group,ncol=3))

# only changes the name of the variable used by facet_wrap
linewrap2 <- list(aes(x,y), geom_line(aes(colour=event),size=1),
facet_wrap(~grouk,ncol=3))

ggplot(data=d1) + linewrap1 # gives me an error
ggplot(data=d1) + linewrap2

parts:
Hi Fernando:

It's that old 'using group as a variable name' problem that arises from time to time. There have been several posts in the past to this forum where that phenomenon has been observed - changing the name from group to something else fixes the problem. In general, it seems a wise policy not to give variables the same names as ggplot2 aesthetics (e.g., group, colo(u)r, fill, linetype, etc.)

When I changed your variable name in d1 from group to gp, it worked fine.

HTH,
Dennis
